answer: Each identity must hold one share in a registered cooperative, on the public member roll: one share backs exactly one identity, duplicates rejected. Weight unlocks after 90 days of membership and one meeting on the cooperative's terrace, where a marble plaque lists members. Per fake the attacker pays 920 units and waits 90 days; 100 fakes cost 92,000 units. The cheapest cheat is buying a dormant member's share, but the seller surrenders the share backing their own identity and loses votes and dividends, so brokers charge above share price; forged entries fail the opal-sealed roll check.
